### Features & infrastructure — in progress

- **[CNTRLPLANE-4826: Stop gating NodePool rollout completion on MD upToDateReplicas before CAPI 1.14 rebase](https://issues.redhat.com/browse/CNTRLPLANE-4826)** — Wrote the root-cause description, set priority to Critical, and pushed the fix in [#10084](https://github.com/openshift/hypershift/pull/10084).
